packageRules.description: Auto-merge patch and minor updates after CI passes; majors stay manual
Auto-merge dev-only dependencies at any version level
Group all non-major updates into a single PR
Group TypeScript type definitions into a single PR
TypeScript: Pin React core libraries below v19
TypeScript: Replace axios with ky (lightweight fetch standard). Our team has standardized on 'ky' over 'axios' for lightweight fetching.
TypeScript: Blacklist Moment.js (deprecated); use date-fns or native Temporal
Python: Pin requests to a safe post-hardening range (>=2.32 floor excludes pre-urllib3-fix releases)
R: Replace reshape2 (Superseded on CRAN) with tidyr; migrate melt()/dcast() to pivot_longer()/pivot_wider()
Rust: Replace async-std (deprecated) with tokio, the maintained async runtime
C#: Pin Newtonsoft.Json to >=13.0.1 to exclude CVE-2024-21907 (DoS in pre-13.0.1)
Go: Replace the deprecated github.com/golang/protobuf module with google.golang.org/protobuf
Julia: Pin JSON.jl to v1.x (1.0 is the 2025 breaking rewrite; excludes legacy 0.21.x)
